summary: Iter189t Rest/Recovery day preview screen fix — VALIDATED. Seeded a workout with workout_type='rest', empty exercises/warmup/cooldown, duration_min=0, coach_notes for client 0b06...84f8c on 2026-08-24 and a control 'Upper Strength' workout on 2026-08-25. As client@crewfit.com verified via Playwright (mobile 390x844): A) rest-day-card renders with green leaf icon, 'REST DAY' title, 'No session scheduled — enjoy the recovery.' sub, and COACH NOTE box containing 'Full recovery. Sleep 8h.'; B) variant-row is absent; C) rpe-input is absent; D) atlas-play (START WORKOUT) is absent; E) complete-workout is a single full-width button labelled 'MARK REST DAY DONE'; F) tapping opens the PostWorkoutRatingSheet; after selecting 'Smooth flight' → 'LOG WORKOUT', POST /api/workouts/{id}/complete succeeded and on revisit the button reads 'REST DAY COMPLETE ✓' with the green background and a COMPLETED status badge is shown. G) Normal workout still shows variant-row, rpe-input, atlas-play ('START WORKOUT →') and small 'MARK DONE' — non-rest path unchanged. Only cosmetic finding: the coach's note is duplicated on rest days (once inside rest-day-card and once via the pre-existing generic COACH NOTE rationale block that is not gated by isRestDay).

ui_bugs.issue: On rest days, coach_notes renders twice — once inside `rest-day-card` and once inside the generic COACH NOTE block at lines 802-807 (`!isCoach && w.coach_notes && ...`). Suggest gating the generic block with `!isRestDay` so the rest-day card is the single source of the coach note.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits 'Unexpected text node: A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' on the workout preview screen. Likely a stray whitespace/newline inside a <View> child — should be wrapped in <Text> or removed. Pre-existing, not introduced by this iteration.

action_items: Optional: hide the generic COACH NOTE rationale block (lines 802-807 in /app/frontend/app/workout/[id]/index.tsx) when isRestDay is true, so the rest-day-card is the sole coach-note surface — currently it displays twice.

Investigate 'Unexpected text node: A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' warning emitted on the workout preview screen — locate the stray whitespace/newline child and wrap it in <Text> or remove it.
critical_code_review_comments: isRestDay memo logic is thorough (workout_type / title / duration_min / total items) and identical in intent to the startWorkout guard — good single-source design.
isRestDay also correctly hides the RPE input via `!isRestDay` on the compBox, and the sticky footer swaps to a single full-width MARK DONE — matches spec.
